reuse.why: Builds every step on the existing shared getScheduledAmount and getApproxNumberThreshold, and replaces schedule-template's own midpoint computation with a call to the shared helper.

duplication.why: Adds no copies; it removes the one inline amount calculation in schedule-template so the rule exists only in getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The worst-case rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the API field is added in the API handler with its own list type, and consumers only pass their op.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps: threading the op to every caller, the API field, the helper change, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: One helper with one extra amountOp argument decides missing, single, approximate and ranged amounts for every consumer, so the next rule change is a one-function edit.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains one amountOp parameter for the real approximate-vs-exact variation; all callers (client components, forecast, schedules app, schedule-template, API, preview transactions) route through it.
